quote: rule("L2 one cycle", len(admitted_cycles) <= 1, f"{admitted_cycles}; unadmitted: {unadmitted}")
summary: With every active Issue un-cycled, admitted_cycles is empty and L2 PASSes (base FAILed with {None}); no fixture covers the zero-admitted case.
failure_scenario: A project where nothing was admitted to a cycle clears L2 silently; the only signal is the free-text 'unadmitted: N' inside a PASS line.

summary: An Issue with no state/type is treated as active; the live fetch always requests state{type}, so only a malformed offline snapshot reaches this, and it fails closed (spurious L9 FAIL) with no diagnostic naming the missing field.
failure_scenario: A trimmed snapshot missing 'state' produces FAIL L9 misattributed to a by-product; untested.
